manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: A* pathing for every unit when every player has it (a game mode the lobby turns on), smarter waypoint pathing for your own units when they do not, and Shift-queued orders as in Warcraft III and StarCraft II.
manifest.name: Pathing

manifest.author: Maxx444, Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Choose how the map looks while paused: grey, in color, or tinted with the pauser's color. A box in your race's dialog art shows who paused and their pauses left. A Resume counts down 3 to 10 seconds (5 by default) with a tick before the game resumes.
manifest.name: Pause Pro

manifest.author: Beau Hastings
manifest.description: Shows one box per player in their color in the top bar, to the right of your food count. Boxes disappear when a player leaves or is defeated, and a divider separates the teams.
